name: Pu Ko
credit: Compiled by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) for András Kornai
statement: Declined. The ISO 639-3 code puk (Pu Ko) was retired in 2017 as non-existent, according to Glottolog; no such language or ethnic group was found in my searches, and there is nothing to build a dossier on.
